notes: A rebel dossier for a state no Cliopatria row covers (a secession from Min that held Jian from 943 and most of Fujian but Fuzhou from 944); added by ea-04-c as a direct counterpart of min. No Wikipedia article title or Wikidata id was opened for Yin as a state (the facts sit on the Wang Yanzheng page), so both are null; the Min article's tree labels it 'Independence of Yin (943-945)'. The pages disagree on Yin's location (northwest of Min in the Southern Tang page, northeast in the Five Dynasties page); Jian Prefecture is the page's own base. The Wang Yanzheng page gives no area and no capital; the capital entry is the power base, with coordinates for modern Jian'ou. Nothing else is known on the opened pages about Yin's government or era names beyond Tiande 943-945.
